Somos uma empresa 100% digital, com tecnologia desenvolvida localmente e líder no mercado de compra e venda online. Nos tornamos a marca que melhor representa a economia circular no país.

Hoje contamos com dois escritórios nas cidades de Rio de Janeiro e São Paulo. Nosso modelo de trabalho flexível oferece autonomia e liberdade para que nossas pessoas elaborem seus padrões e rotinas com disciplina e protagonismo na conexão com negócio, as prioridades e o propósito da empresa.

  • Garantir uso disciplinado das ferramentas de gestão (ex: Jira, Confluence, dashboards), com foco em previsibilidade e valor.

E o que você precisa ter?

  • Experiência sólida como Gerente de Projetos / Delivery Manager , atuando em iniciativas estratégicas e complexas;
  • Vivência em ambientes multidisciplinares , com múltiplos stakeholders e profundo conhecimento em metodologias ágeis;

O Líder de Suporte de Rua será responsável por garantir a alta performance, disciplina operacional e engajamento do time de campo, atuando como ponto central entre a equipe, gestão regional e demais áreas da empresa.

Suas Principais Atividades Serão:

Gestão de Pessoas e Performance

  • Conduzir feedbacks individuais semanais, garantindo acompanhamento contínuo das entregas, comportamento e desenvolvimento profissional.
  • Atuar ativamente no engajamento do time, promovendo um ambiente saudável, colaborativo e motivador.
  • Monitorar e intervir no clima organizacional, identificando riscos, oportunidades e propondo ações de melhoria.
  • Realizar gestão de absenteísmo e produtividade, garantindo aderência aos processos, cumprimento de metas e escalas.

Controle Administrativo

  • Gerenciar controle de horas, escala, jornadas, férias e banco de horas do time de rua.
  • Acompanhar e validar apropriações diárias, garantindo conformidade operacional.
  • Zelar pela correta utilização e acompanhamento dos recursos disponibilizados, como motos e equipamentos.

Treinamento e Integração

  • Planejar e executar treinamentos técnicos e comportamentais para a equipe.
  • Conduzir o processo de integração de novos colaboradores, garantindo alinhamento de cultura, processos e expectativas.

Gestão de Resultados

  • Preparar e apresentar relatórios de performance ao Supervisor Regional, ao time de rua e ao CM da filial.
  • Acompanhar e analisar indicadores de operação para direcionar estratégias de melhoria contínua.
  • Buscar sempre melhoria do indicador do suporte de rua, atendendo os clientes de forma rápida e eficaz.
  • Buscar táticas regionais de recolhimento de inadimplência, criar estratégias de baixo custo e eficiência para recolhimentos distantes.

KPIs (Indicadores de Desempenho)

  • Clima e satisfação do time

Somos a maior empresa de aluguel de motos do mundo, fundada em 2020, com mais de 170.000 motos em circulação e presença em mais de 100 filiais no Brasil e México. Em setembro de 2023 concluímos nossa rodada Series C de US$ 50 milhões, liderada por grandes nomes do Venture Capital.

Buscamos um(a) Data Specialist para se juntar ao nosso time realizando análises estratégicas sobre o comportamento de clientes, construção de pipelines de dados, desenvolvimento de dashboards e automações. A pessoa será responsável também por interagir com diferentes stakeholders internos, conectando dados às decisões de negócio.

Requisitos do perfil

Hard skills / Técnicas

  • SQL: sólido conhecimento para consultas, modelagem e manipulação de dados.
  • Python: experiência com análise de dados, automação de processos e manutenção de scripts (incluindo web crawlers).
  • Power BI: domínio na construção de dashboards, DAX e linguagem M.
  • Databricks ou similar: experiência com construção de pipelines e integração de dados em ambiente cloud.

Soft skills

  • Forte capacidade analítica e visão de negócio.
  • Facilidade de comunicação e relacionamento com múltiplos stakeholders.
  • Proatividade para identificar oportunidades de melhoria e automação.
  • Organização e autonomia para gerir demandas simultâneas.

Diferenciais

  • Conhecimentos em Machine Learning e métodos estatísticos.
  • Experiência prévia com projetos de Customer Analytics.
  • Conhecimento em e-commerce e CRM.
  • Conhecimento nas ferramentas: Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Salesforce Marketing Cloud e Google Analytics.

Compromisso de Inclusão

Na Amaris Consulting, temos o compromisso de promover um ambiente inclusivo que valoriza a diversidade. Incentivamos candidaturas de todas as pessoas qualificadas, independentemente de gênero, origem, orientação sexual ou crenças.

title: Accessibility Manager
description:
Department: Social Responsibility & Education

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

The Position

The FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 Accessibility Manager working alongside the FIFA Zurich Human Rights and Anti-Discrimination team and reporting to the Head of Sustainability supports the successful development and implementation of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ with a particular focus on accessibility and inclusivity. This role plays an integral part in ensuring a successful tournament through the implementation of accessible infrastructure and services.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage the delivery of key Sustainability & Human Rights Strategy initiatives to ensure an accessible FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ for disabled people and people with limited mobility, including:
  • Auditing of official FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ sites against FIFA’s accessibility requirements.
  • Ensuring improvements to fulfil those requirements are implemented.
  • Working with multiple functional areas and stakeholders to ensure accessible services and guidance are delivered for participants, attendees and workforce.
  • Developing and delivering accessibility training and awareness raising for key functional areas and stakeholders.
  • Liaise with and/or support host cities and other organisations in Brazil or functional areas in their delivery of initiatives that:
  • Facilitate accessibility for disabled people and people with limited mobility across physical infrastructure, public transport and services in Brazil.
  • Build local accessibility expertise to deliver the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ and foster the development of the sports and events industries in the region.
  • Empower people in the region through football programmes and the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ platform.
  • As a member of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ Sustainability & Human Rights Team:
  • Design and implement sustainable procurement practices that facilitate a welcoming and accessible tournament experience for participants, attendees and workforce.
  • Work closely with FIFA Human Rights & Anti-Discrimination staff based in Zurich and relevant teams within the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ entity to deliver jointly managed projects and activities.
  • Assist the planning and coordination of meetings, workshops and site visits.

Your Profile – Minimum Requirements

  • A deep passion for sustainability and inclusivity, driven to leverage the unique value of mega‑sporting events to contribute to sustainable development goals and the promotion of responsible business practices.
  • Deep familiarity with national and international accessibility standards for disabled people.
  • At least 5 years of work experience implementing accessibility programmes.
  • Experience of working in a comparable role in an international, fast‑paced environment, complex project, preferably in the events and/or sports industry.
  • Proven track record of generating productive stakeholder relationships that successfully deliver sustainability/social responsibility outcomes.
  • Demonstrated ability in event planning and event project management, prioritise effectively, and work independently.
  • Proficiency in written and verbal English communication.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint), planning software and online collaboration tools.

Additional Advantages

  • University degree in social sciences, human rights, equality, diversity and/or international relations.
  • In‑depth knowledge of social responsibility issues, particularly in the context of mega‑sporting events.
  • Experience developing and delivering capacity‑building programmes and training material for internal and external stakeholders.
  • Sustainability performance management, reporting and communications experience.
  • Experience working in sports and/or events.
  • International work experience.

Unique Knowledge and Skills

  • Quick learner with the ability to grasp complex structures, projects and relationships in a short timeframe.
  • Self‑motivated, extremely well organised, proactive and accurate.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong relationship building and conflict resolution skills.
  • Capacity for interacting with people of diverse cultures and backgrounds.
  • Knowledge of worldwide socio‑political and sustainability issues.

Requirements

  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Bilingual – Portuguese and English.
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro until the beginning of the tournament and to the assigned host city for the tournament operational period.

title: Roaming IREG Engineer - Lisbon-based
description:
Posted date: 1/12/2026

Type: Full-time

1GLOBAL is a technology-driven global mobile communications leader, built to help enterprises unlock the full potential of mobile connectivity at scale. Powered by a best-in-class telecom platform – including our own owned and operated global mobile core network, a full end-to-end eSIM technology stack, and an extensive portfolio of telecom licenses – 1GLOBAL operates as a fully regulated telecommunications provider across 40 countries worldwide. Combined with our privileged access to the global wholesale telecom market, this positions us uniquely to deliver seamless, compliant, and scalable connectivity solutions anywhere in the world.

We serve many of the world’s leading banks, enterprises, and digital-first businesses, including neo‑banks, fast‑moving consumer goods companies, travel leaders, and payment service providers. Today, 1GLOBAL connects more than 70 million people and devices globally, enabling our customers to launch, scale, and innovate with confidence in the mobile ecosystem.

1GLOBAL is a profitable, fast‑growing business. With full‑year revenues exceeding US$200 million and profits of over US$25 million, we generate strong cash flows and fund our growth independently—continuously investing in infrastructure, platform innovation, and global expansion. Recent years have marked a defining phase in our journey, with major enterprise and mass‑consumer client wins accelerating our evolution into a global mobile connectivity powerhouse, purpose‑built to enable consumer brands to enter and succeed with their own telecommunications offerings.

Founded in 2022 by experienced technology entrepreneurs Hakan Koç and Pyrros Koussios, 1GLOBAL has rapidly emerged as a European technology leader shaping the future of global telecommunications. We operate as a fully regulated Mobile Virtual Network Operator (MVNO) in 12 countries and as a regulated telecom operator in an additional 28 markets. Headquartered in the Netherlands, with world‑class R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, our team of close to 500 experts across 15 countries is united by a single ambition: to redefine global mobile connectivity through technology, scale, and execution excellence.

Position Overview

1Global is seeking a talented and detail‑oriented RoamingIREG Engineer to manage the entire roaming process and procedures. As an IREG Engineer you will be responsible for the technical setup, testing, and maintenance of international roaming and interconnect services. We’re looking for a proactive individual with a strong technical foundation, adept at troubleshooting support cases and enhancing operational processes for seamless footprint updates.

This is a Lisbon‑based position, and relocation will be required. Relocation support may be provided for the selected candidate.

Key Responsibilities

  • Plan, execute, and document IREG tests (IR.24, IR.35, IR.50, etc.) for voice, SMS, and data services, in line with GSMA standards.
  • Set up and verify interconnect links for voice and messaging services with partner operators.
  • Monitor roaming service KPIs, troubleshoot issues, and ensure compliance with roaming agreements.
  • Configure and test SS7, Diameter, SIP, and related signaling protocols for international connectivity.
  • Liaise with foreign operators, roaming hubs, and internal teams during implementation and troubleshooting.
  • Maintain up‑to‑date test results, network configurations, and operational procedures.
  • Oversee the footprint management of all 1Global products, working closely with the wholesale and other networks team.

Requirements

Must Have

  • Perform end-to-end roaming testing (voice, SMS, data, CAMEL, VoLTE, 5G roaming).
  • Execute IREG test cases according to GSMA guidelines and bilateral agreements.
  • Analyze and troubleshoot roaming issues with signaling traces and logs.
  • Work closely with international roaming partners to resolve interconnect problems.
  • Manage and update roaming documentation (IR.21).
  • Support new roaming launches (testing and activation of new operators, technologies, and services).
  • Coordinate with internal teams (Core Network, Billing, etc.) during testing and troubleshooting.
  • Validate TAP files and charging/billing aspects of roaming services.
  • Monitor KPIs and performance of roaming services after launch.
  • Follow-up and define Quality and Performance indicators for the entire roaming service.
  • Close relationship with external partners like carriers, service providers.
  • Have successful partnerships with other departments and teams.

Qualifications

  • Degree in Telecom Engineering or Computer Science or equivalent experience.
  • Knowledge of 3GPP, ETSI, standards and specifications for SIM/eSIM.
  • Knowledge and experience with protocols such as MAP, S6a.
  • Familiar with an RSP architecture and experience operating it.
  • Knowledge in scripting and have basic programming skills.
  • Experience with protocol analyzer tools like Wireshark, Astelia, and ability to use them to troubleshoot networks errors/problems for the mentioned protocols.
  • Experience with ETSI NFV architecture and solutions.
  • Familiar with MVNO/MVNE/MVNA architecture(s) and landscape.

What we offer

  • CLT contract — enjoy job stability and reliable benefits that value your work.
  • Quarterly performance bonuses to reward your hard work and achievements.
  • Meal allowance paid into Caju card — R$100 per working day.
  • Health insurance with SulAmérica — 50% covered by the company.
  • Daycare allowance provided to mothers with children under 3 years old — R$500 per month per child.
  • Kickstart your journey with an exciting welcome onboarding trip to one of our European offices (Lisbon or Berlin)!

Why 1GLOBAL

  • Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 100% year-on-year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs.
  • Major Transaction Exposure: Be in the driver’s seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry.
  • Work with a Talented Team: From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors, and constantly being exposed to talented and driven individuals.
  • Dynamic Work Environment: Thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts.
  • Professional Development: Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills and knowledge in a cutting‑edge field.
  • International Experience: Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world as you grow within the company.
  • Open Communication Culture: Join a team where your ideas are heard, and open dialogue is encouraged, fostering a supportive and transparent work environment.
  • Get Things Done Attitude: Be part of a results-driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry.

1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer; we value your character as much as your talent. Diversity drives our innovation, and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment. We are excited for you to join our mission to revolutionise connectivity globally.

No agencies. We do not accept CVs from 3rd parties.

Mindrift connects specialists with project‑based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project‑based, not permanent employment.

  • Design original computational physics problems that simulate real physics research workflows.

  • Experience with numerical simulation methods.
  • Ability to design problems that mirror real physics research workflows.
  • Creative thinking in problem design across diverse physics areas.
  • Familiarity with physics modeling and approximation techniques.
  • Strong written English (C1+).

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10‑20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active.

title: Junior Ubuntu Software Engineer
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

We are hiring junior engineers to work across the breadth of our Ubuntu Engineering organisation – engineers who care deeply for quality, performance and resilience in software, engineers who are just as comfortable designing and engineering new software as they are packaging, integrating, testing and shipping the incredible catalog of open source software provided by the Ubuntu repositories.

Our engineers integrate the freshest open source software, provide robust upgrade paths and engineer the future of Ubuntu. Ubuntu is not just the world's most deployed open source operating system, it's a platform that enables innovation for millions of users across the globe. Our community represents the full breadth of the developer experience; from students, hobbyists and freelancers to high performance engineering and creative teams in corporate and academic environments.

Key Teams that Ship Ubuntu

  • Foundations : maintaining foundational software: architectures, package managers, compilers, toolchains, bootloaders, filesystems and core utilities
  • Server: leading the design, evolution and future of our Ubuntu Server distribution
  • Desktop: driving Ubuntu Desktop, our future immutable desktop: Ubuntu Core Desktop, WSL, gaming technology, and a suite of modern applications for the desktop crafted with Flutter
  • Debcrafters: a new team responsible for the forward movement, maintenance and overall health of the Ubuntu archive: one of the most abundant repositories of open source software available today

Bring your existing expertise and learn new skills by working on one of the most prolific pieces of open source software. As an engineer working on Ubuntu you could work on any or all of the following categories:

Possible categories of work

  • Development : design, build and ship new foundational systems software and applications in Rust, Go, Flutter, and Python
  • Architecture : engineer the integration of open source from boot firmware to cloud applications deployment
  • Packaging : a combination of Debian and Snap packaging to ship software in the distribution
  • Automation : build and maintain the machinery responsible for building, testing and shipping Ubuntu
  • Distro Engineering : the maintenance and evolution of a Linux distribution and its repositories

If you have skills in those areas, or you have other skills you believe could contribute to Ubuntu, and you're keen to get started building your career in open source, then this is the role for you. Our junior career path caters for both new graduates and early career engineers.

At Canonical, you will have the opportunity to engage with and contribute to the broader open source community. We're looking for individuals who can help build a thriving community and contribute with enthusiasm and precision to a broad range of technologies.

Location

We have remote roles open in every time zone.

The role entails

Based on the first round of interviews, we identify specific teams where you might be an excellent fit and conduct second-round interviews with those teams. Our engineers are:

  • Designing, building and shipping software in Rust, Go, Python and C/C++
  • Packaging, integrating, testing and uploading open source software to the Ubuntu repositories
  • Debugging issues, then designing and delivering robust solutions
  • Authoring and improving technical and community documentation
  • Contributing to upstream and neighboring open source projects
  • Collaborating as part of a globally distributed team
  • Continuously learning and progressing their technical and professional skills

What we are looking for in you

  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
  • Drive and a track record of going above and beyond expectations
  • A passion for open source software
  • Experience with Rust, Go, Python, Flutter or C/C++
  • Professional written and spoken English
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks each

Nice-to-have skills

  • Familiarity with Linux distributions
  • Familiarity with system debugging tools and techniques
  • Familiarity with automation tooling and CI/CD systems
  • Experience contributing to open source projects

What we offer you

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence – in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Placement Readiness Specialist (Fully Remote)
description:
Your Role

At Virtual Internships, we help students worldwide turn potential into opportunity.

As a Placement Readiness Specialist, your mission is to coach and guide interns through the placement matching process with empathy, confidence and warmth.

You’ll thrive here if you love seeing people grow, take pride in measurable impact, and find joy in helping others take their next professional step.

This is a fast-paced, collaborative role where empathy meets accountability and coaching meets operations.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Coaching interns by running mock interviews, giving actionable feedback, and helping them present their best selves.
  • Deliver engaging bootcamp sessions and support interns in developing essential soft skills, and build workplace readiness.
  • Guiding interns through key pre-internship moments by helping them prepare for interviews, make confident decisions, and manage expectations with calm, clear communication.
  • Championing clarity by reinforcing program guidelines, simplifying complex choices, and ensuring every intern keeps moving forward with confidence, while feeling supported.

Why You’ll Love This Role

  • You’ll see real impact: Every success story starts with you - a career launchpad. The clarity and confidence you build during the placement matching process directly shape interns’ growth and success.
  • You’ll grow fast: Gain hands‑on experience in coaching, education, and program management within a global EdTech startup.
  • You’ll be empowered: We value autonomy and trust you to experiment, learn and own your outcomes.
  • You’ll make a global impact: Your work helps level the playing field for learners around the world.
  • (P.S. The secret password is “Clarity”—you’ll need it later!)

Who We’re Looking For

Your Attributes

  • You own the outcome: You take initiative, navigate ambiguity, and always find a way forward. You see challenges as opportunities to deliver results.
  • You level up fast: You seek feedback early, apply it quickly and share what you learn. You’re humble, curious, and growth‑oriented.
  • You balance accountability with empathy: You understand that support and accountability go hand in hand, creating trust while ensuring progress.
  • You turn complexity into clarity: You simplify, communicate with compassion and close loops so everyone knows next steps.
  • You thrive in a global, remote team: You’re comfortable across time zones and cultures.

Your Experience

You’ll bring 1–3 years of experience in one or more of these areas, but more importantly, you’ll have stories that show how you’ve helped people move from uncertainty to readiness and potential to performance.

  • Career Services / University Advising: You’ve helped students or graduates prepare for jobs or internships through resume reviews, mock interviews or confidence‑building sessions.
  • Learning & Development / Coaching: You’ve guided individuals or groups through growth, skill‑building or mindset shifts.
  • Program Management / Education Services: You’ve delivered structured, human‑centered programs that balance impact and efficiency.
  • Working in a Remote Environment: You know how to navigate time zones, cultures and asynchronous communication with ease.

You’ll stand out from the crowd if:

  • You’ve coached or mentored students through recruitment or early career programs.
  • You naturally balance empathy with accountability.
  • You get energy from helping others succeed, you’re motivated by progress and transformation.
  • Communicate with warmth and precision, knowing when to challenge and when to reassure.
  • Balance speed with quality. You move fast but you don’t cut corners.

If you’re passionate about helping people grow and love connecting ownership with empathy, we’d love to hear from you even if you don’t tick every box.

Virtual Internships Perks and Benefits

  • Remote‑First: All roles at VI are currently and will remain remote - flexibility to work from anywhere.
  • Flexible Working Hours: Start earlier, leave earlier, take a shorter lunch or leave later, it’s totally up to you.
  • Annual Leave: Wherever you are in the world, you’ll get 25 days of paid annual leave per year, plus bank holidays and 5 sick days.
  • Life Event Leave: There are moments in life where your responsibilities are a higher priority than work (e.g. moving house, your best friend getting married, your sister having a baby). Therefore, you’ll get 5 days of paid life‑event leave to support these occasions. You also get a day off on your birthday. This is in addition to your annual leave.
  • Tech: New joiners receive a budget for a company laptop depending on the role and location.

Equality & Diversity

Virtual Internships is an equal opportunity employer, committed to equality and diversity amongst both our employees and prospective applicants. We ensure all applicants are treated equally and fairly throughout our recruitment process.

title: Technical Author (multiple roles and seniority levels)
description:
Our ambition is to set a standard of excellence in the industry for technical documentation and documentation practice. This is your chance to be a part of that, as a Technical Author at Canonical .

We have dozens of positions available across the organisation, at all levels from Graduate to Senior Staff. These roles will lead documentation efforts within engineering, business operations, or other areas of the company.

The role of a Technical Author

A product-focused Technical Author is a member of a product engineering team, typically focusing on one product or family of products. You will help the team develop documentation that serves users' needs and contribute to the long‑term success of the project.

A customer‑focused Technical Author works with teams such as Field Engineering, Customer Success, or Support, dealing with users of complex software suites in custom configurations. You will take a responsive approach to documentation problems and develop strong technical and contextual knowledge.

An operations‑focused Technical Author is part of a business team (e.g., Legal, HR, or Talent) and maintains internal documentation such as employee handbooks. You will help improve materials relied upon by hundreds of colleagues and define communication patterns for a growing organization.

You will also be part of Canonical’s documentation practice team, working with other Technical Authors to define excellence and drive resources across the company and the open‑source community.

Location

Fully remote roles open to candidates worldwide.

As a Technical Author you will

  • Create, maintain, and improve software and other documentation.
  • Work with team members to help them make effective documentation contributions.
  • Influence the development of Canonical products and services as an expert user with opinions about function and design.
  • Engage with user communities to ensure that the documentation meets their needs.
  • Encourage and support community engagement in and contribution to documentation.
  • Help standardise the structure, presentation, style and language of content across products.
  • Collaborate with documentation peers to advance the state of the art at Canonical.
  • Challenge and advance documentation understanding and best practices as part of a disciplinary team.

A strong candidate

  • Is an excellent collaborator and communicator.
  • Cares deeply about functional written communication.
  • Is a technical writer with a programmer’s mindset, or a programmer with a record of excellent documentation.
  • Has a record of community engagement in open‑source software, documentation, research, or related disciplines.
  • Is sympathetic to the needs and challenges of open‑source communities.
  • Demonstrates technical curiosity and a fascination with software technology.
  • Has demonstrable documentation skills, insight, and enthusiasm.
  • Has experience in software development contexts.
  • Is familiar with Linux, command line, Git, and documentation markup languages such as reStructuredText or MyST.
  • Holds a BSc/BA degree or equivalent.
  • Is able to travel twice a year for up to two weeks for events.

Nice‑to‑have skills

  • Deep technical domain knowledge.
  • Open‑source community leadership and management.
  • User‑experience, interaction, or visual design.

What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance when shaping compensation worldwide. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance‑driven annual bonus or commission. We provide benefits that reflect our values and ideals and meet local needs.

  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly in‑person team sprints.
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year.
  • Annual compensation review.
  • Recognition rewards.
  • Annual holiday leave.
  • Maternity and paternity leave.
  • Employee Assistance Programme.
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues.
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long‑haul company events.

Canonical is an equal‑opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Como é o ambiente de trabalho?

Na DPSP (lojas, CDs e corporativo), nosso trabalho impacta a saúde e o bem‑estar de milhões de brasileiros todos os dias. Nossa força está nas pessoas que colocam saúde em primeiro lugar, atuam com ética, colaboração e respeito às diferenças. Junte-se a nós e seja protagonista na transformação da jornada de saúde de quem confia na gente.

Mais do que igualdade, buscamos equidade: Aqui, temos espaço para sermos autênticos, independentemente de gênero, etnia, raça, orientação sexual, credo ou deficiência. Destacamos que todas as nossas vagas são abertas para pessoas com deficiência (PCD).

#VemSerDPSP

Responsabilidades

  • Assegurar o funcionamento dos equipamentos de automação, mecânica e predial, apoiando nas manutenções corretivas, preditivas e preventivas dos equipamentos do CD;
  • Apoiar nos atendimentos emergenciais solicitados pela operação e manutenção;
  • Apoiar na gestão do estoque de materiais para manutenção, identificando itens necessários para reposição e reportando ao supervisor eventuais faltas, para garantir a continuidade dos processos e evitar paradas operacionais;
  • Acompanhar o desempenho dos equipamentos e identificar oportunidades de melhoria, realizando testes e verificações técnicas para reduzir falhas e aumentar a vida útil dos componentes de automação, mecânica e predial;
  • Apoiar a equipe em projetos de instalação e expansão de novos equipamentos no CD, verificando o funcionamento e a conformidade técnica durante o processo de instalação, para assegurar que os dispositivos atendam às necessidades da operação;
  • Realizar ajustes mecânicos utilizando conhecimento em caldeiraria e solda para pequenos e grandes reparos no CD;
  • Realizar manutenção predial como: manutenção em sistemas hidráulicos (canos e tubulações), reparo em estruturas de alvenaria, executar serviço hidrossanitário, pinturas em estruturas metálicas, parede e outras superfícies, mudança de layout do CD, como prateleiras, salas adm, instalação de fechaduras, portas, dobradiças, mobiliários;
  • Apoiar os técnicos de manutenção mecânica e elétrica, nas atividades de manutenção preventiva, corretiva e emergencial, auxiliando nos ajustes dos equipamentos de automação e mecânica;
  • Realizar reparos e substituições de peças mecânicas, pneumáticas e hidráulicas;

Registrar o trabalho realizado reportando ao cliente mediante ordem de serviço e planejamento do PCM.

title: Regional Site Coordinator (HYBRID) | BRAZIL
description:
Regional Site Coordinator (HYBRID) | BRAZIL

Full-Time Rio de Janeiro, Rio de Janeiro, BR

Overview

PURPOSE: Responsible for managing the portfolio of towers and roofs. Responsibilities include integration and maintenance of new and existing towers, roofs, and tenant facilities.

Responsibilities

  • Interface between the Sales Manager and the operators in the leasing, site design, modification and installation processes.
  • Establish and maintain daily plans for multiple contracts/projects as needed; Work directly with clients with the support of internal and external resources.
  • Comply with all accounting requirements required for each project, including requisitions, purchase orders, invoice approvals, report review, etc.
  • Validate the technical feasibility of any request to modify the load on the towers as well as space on the floor or roof terraces.
  • Planning, coordination and monitoring of the execution of preventive maintenance.
  • Corrective maintenance programming derived from inspections and direct reports from operators, contractors and owners.
  • Keep updated the information systems, database, maintenance reports and automated controls of the projects.
  • Safeguard the physical records of the existing sites.
  • Validate that the delivery of the projects meets the requirements established in the project planning and request pertinent actions in case there are discrepancies.
  • Guarantee compliance with all internal regulations and federal, state and local safety, environmental and zoning code conditions. Ref.: civil aviation regulations on tower lighting and painting.
  • Facilitate inspections of towers and buildings, as needed.
  • Resolution of access problems that cannot be executed by the Monitoring Center (NOC).
  • Coordinate projects that require relocation, modification, consolidation, decommissioning of sites, compliance with safety regulations, site improvements, etc. As required.
  • Provide support or assistance to the Mergers and Acquisitions department by conducting infrastructure audits of assets being considered for purchase or site management opportunities.
  • Preparation of project status reports and reports as required, considering KPIs and reporting.

These job functions are representative of tasks accomplished by incumbents. The list is not exhaustive; incumbents perform other related tasks.

Working conditions and physical demands

Position works in a normal office environment and in the field. Standing, sitting, and walking required daily. Job will involve minimal travel.

Qualifications

  • Professional in careers such as Civil Engineering, Construction Engineering, Architecture or Electrical, Electronic or Telecommunications Engineering.
  • Minimum experience of 4 years in construction project management, preferably in the telecommunications area (construction of sites, development of wireless communications, maintenance and installation of power lines, etc.).
  • Knowledge of passive telecommunications infrastructure (towers, masts, poles, ducts and the physical place where they are located)
  • Proficient user of Excel and other MS Office suite products, as well as Power BI, MS Project, AutoCAD Viewer, etc.
  • Ability to identify problems or opportunities for improvement to optimize the functioning of the infrastructures under their monitoring and care.
  • Orientation towards service, users, clients or different interest groups with which the company maintains relations.
  • Disciplined, organized person with attention to detail
  • Ability to comply with standards, policies and regulations applicable to each case. (internal or local regulations).
  • Ability to establish, manage and take care of relationships with clients (representatives of telecommunications operators that access the towers) and suppliers (preventive/corrective maintenance contractors of the telecommunications infrastructures).

It is the policy and practice of this Company to prohibit any form of discrimination or harassment based on race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, transgender status, national origin, age, disability, military or veteran status, or status in any group protected by federal, state or local law.

As the identity team engineering manager you will bring significant software development experience, Kubernetes knowledge and a keen eye for software design, performance and security. You will be responsible for working with product management to define the technical vision for the products, managing the team backlog, reviewing code and coaching younger team members. description:
Senior Manager, Ocean PolicyConservation International protects nature for the benefit of humanity. Through science, policy, fieldwork, and finance, we spotlight and secure the most important places in nature for the climate, biodiversity, and for people. With offices in 30 countries and projects in more than 100 countries, Conservation International partners with governments, companies, civil society, Indigenous peoples, and local communities to help people and nature thrive together.POSITION SUMMARYThis position is open for consideration in the following locations in the Americas, with preference for candidates based in time zones that can accommodate calls with colleagues in Europe and Africa: Arlington-US, Brazil(remote), Colombia, Costa Rica, Ecuador, Guyana, Mexico, Suriname, PeruOver the last 10 years, CI has developed a comprehensive Blue Climate program spanning over 20 countries dedicated to identifying and addressing science and policy priorities for oceans and climate globally. The Blue Climate program within the Center for Oceans at CI works closely with our field programs across the Americas, Asia-Pacific and Africa to design and implement innovative approaches to (1) implement nature-based climate adaptation solutions that improve coastal and marine communities’ livelihoods and resilience while also conserving ecosystems and biodiversity;
and (2) conserve and restore coastal blue carbon ecosystems (mangroves, salt marshes, and seagrass meadows) for climate change mitigation. The Blue Climate program also has key leadership roles in advancing climate mitigation and adaptation priorities into national and regional coastal management and science through the International Blue Carbon Institute, Blue Carbon Initiative, the International Partnership for Blue Carbon, the Global Mangrove Alliance and the Global Green-Gray Community of Practice, and policy with the Center for Policy and Incentives.Under the supervision of the Director, Ocean Policy, the Senior Manager, Ocean Policy, is a self-motivated, creative team member integral to the long-term growth and success of CI’s Blue Climate program and Ocean Policy team. The Senior Manager, Ocean Policy will support the development, implementation and management of strategic international policy‑based approaches and programs to achieve CI’s Ocean Policy goals spanning coastal resilience, climate mitigation, green‑gray infrastructure, blue carbon ecosystems and ocean‑climate integration. Together with the Director, Ocean Policy, they will work with CI’s Center for Policy and Incentives to ensure alignment with CI’s larger international and national policy programs and priorities, including providing technical inputs and guidance on ocean‑climate issues. The position will also work closely with teams across CI including other programs within the Center for Oceans and the Moore Center for Science and Solutions to ensure alignment and integration of ocean policy priorities with all related CI programs and topic areas, including biodiversity, finance, and community fisheries.RESPONSIBILITIESInternational Ocean Policy- Manage strategic policy initiatives to achieve CI’s Ocean Policy goals spanning coastal resilience, green‑gray infrastructure, blue carbon, and other ocean‑climate areas which integrate and align international and national policy goals.- Work closely with CI’s Center for Policy and Incentives to ensure ocean‑climate strategies and approaches are aligned with international and national policy programs and priorities.- Play a key role in project development, fundraising, implementation, communications, and broader capacity building for the Ocean Policy program.- Contribute to the drafting and revision of CI ocean policy positions, policy briefs, guidance documents, and other technical resources.- Play a key role in representing the Center for Oceans within the CI delegation to international policy meetings related to climate, biodiversity, and oceans, such as the UNFCCC climate COP and intersessional meetings. Additionally, support CI’s strategic engagement in these spaces (e.G., side events, meetings with countries and partners).- Support the development and management of relationships and partnerships with government representatives and like‑minded organizations to accelerate and achieve CI ocean policy objectives in close coordination with CI’s international policy team and relevant country programs.Ocean Policy Advancement in Priority Countries- In partnership with CI country programs, the International Blue Carbon Institute, and the Center for Policy and Incentives, support the development and implementation of national or regional ocean policy objectives and programs which are aligned with and inform CI’s Blue Climate and broader policy priorities.- Provide CI programs and partners with strategic support, technical expertise, and/or capacity building for the integration of coastal ecosystems into Nationally Determined Contributions and implementation plans, national climate and ocean policy, greenhouse gas inventories, NBSAPs and other related components of ocean‑climate policy.- As needed, facilitate in‑person and virtual meetings, workshops, and related events with national governments and local partners to advance the priorities of CI country programs in alignment with national objectives.- Support the Ocean Policy Director in scoping new policy activities in accordance with existing CI programs.Blue Climate Program- Contribute to strategy development, planning processes, fundraising, team initiatives/special projects, reporting and communication efforts as needed.- Coordinate with other teams across the Blue Climate network team to ensure programmatic alignment and synergies between CI projects.Other duties as assigned by supervisor.WORKING some days from the office and some days remotely. title: Senior Legal Counsel
description:
Wärtsilä is a world leader in marine technology and leading the industry’s transformation towards a decarbonised and sustainable future. With the world’s widest portfolio and service network, we – Wärtsilians - deliver efficient, safe and sustainable integrated products and solutions to enhance the business of our customers. The opportunities presented through digitalisation and new technologies are offering a new era of shipping. Did you know that shipping is the world’s most efficient mode of transportation and that 88% of the world’s trade is carried by sea? We want to change the course towards an interconnected and cleaner maritime future and are constantly on the lookout for future‑oriented talent to join our team and to work towards enabling sustainable societies through innovation in technology and services‑together. Are you ready to jump onboard?Would you like to be part of Wärtsilä’s journey to decarbonise the maritime industry? Marine Legal & Compliance supports Wärtsila’s Marine businesses by enabling growth, safeguarding the business, and upholding trust. The team works across the full contract lifecycle and helps the business balance commercial opportunity with legal, compliance, financial, operational, and reputational risk. This role will serve as a senior regional legal partner for Latin America, with a strong focus on commercial contracting, compliance‑sensitive transactions, dispute prevention and handling, and business partnering across sales, delivery, lifecycle, and selected strategic initiatives.Senior Legal CounselMain responsibilities- Draft, review, structure, and negotiate complex commercial agreements in support of Marine businesses, including project sales, equipment delivery, lifecycle/service agreements, framework agreements, amendments, NDAs, notices, and other legal documentation.- Provide practical, solutions‑oriented legal advice to business stakeholders in Latin America across the full contract lifecycle, including pre‑bid, bid, negotiation, execution, delivery, claims, and Compliance policies, including use of contract templates, GTCs, approval matrices, and deviation processes.- Partner closely with Sales, Project Delivery, lifecycle/service teams, business control, risk, compliance, trade compliance, safety, cyber, data privacy, sourcing, and other internal stakeholders to ensure that legal and compliance considerations are addressed in commercial activities.- Advise on cross‑border and public‑sector / state‑owned‑customer transactions in the region, including risk allocation, liability, subcontracting, assignment, delivery, compliance, and procurement‑related issues.- Support compliance and integrity initiatives relevant to the region, including anti‑corruption, Know Your Business Partner / third‑party risk, Code of Conduct, and related awareness‑building.- Contribute to legal training, template development, continuous improvement, and simplification of contracting processes, and help business teams understand when and how to involve Marine Legal & Compliance.- Provide legal support in strategic areas relevant to Marine’s current priorities, including decarbonisation, new fuels, regulatory implementation, safety, and selected digital/cyber/data issues as they arise in regional transactions.Required qualifications- Qualified to practice law in Brazil or, alternatively, in the relevant jurisdiction of hire.- Strong post‑graduation legal experience as a practising attorney at a reputable law firm, and preferably as in‑house counsel.- Strong experience drafting and negotiating sophisticated commercial agreements in Portuguese and English;
ability to also draft and negotiate in Spanish is strongly preferred.- Demonstrated ability to advise business stakeholders independently, negotiate high‑complexity matters, and balance legal protection with commercial practicality.Preferred experience- Experience supporting marine, industrial equipment, lifecycle/service, energy, oil & gas, infrastructure, or other technically complex B2B sectors.- Experience with Latin American civil‑law jurisdictions, especially Brazil and broader South/Central America.- Experience with public procurement / government‑related counterparties, state‑owned entities, or other regulated counterparties.- Familiarity with anti‑corruption, third‑party risk / KYBP, data/privacy, trade compliance, cyber/security‑related clauses, and policy‑based contract governance.- Experience delivering internal training, building playbooks/templates, and working in a policy‑driven contracting environment.What success looks like in this role- Trusted legal partner to Marine stakeholders in Latin America.- Strong, business‑facing negotiator who can lead matters independently in Portuguese and English, and preferably Spanish.- Able to identify the big picture quickly, understand the contract and the business need, assess legal/commercial/compliance risk, involve the right stakeholders, and move matters forward pragmatically.- Collaborative, commercially minded, solution‑oriented, and comfortable operating in a matrixed global organization.You will join a highly capable global legal and compliance team that plays a central role in supporting Wärtsilä Marine’s commercial, compliance, and decarbonisation agenda. Marine Legal & Compliance works at the intersection of contracting, technology, regulation, safety, and strategic business partnering, with opportunities to contribute meaningfully to both regional business execution and wider global initiatives.At Wärtsilä we value, respect and embrace all our differences, and are committed to diversity, inclusion and equal employment opportunities;

title: Landholder And Reforestation Delivery Manager
description:
About NatureCo NatureCo delivers nature-based solutions (NbS) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. NatureCo has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market. NatureCo is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits. We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. NatureCo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all. Role and responsibilities The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for NatureCo’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality. The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo. Primary roles and responsibilities include: Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs);
plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions. Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current. Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner. Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation. Eligibility, due diligence & agreements Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks). Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation Lead closure of contract signatures. Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within NatureCo’s data management system (land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records). Reforestation delivery enablement Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows). Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation. Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints). Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress). Stakeholder engagement and safeguards Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with NatureCo policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos). Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the NatureCo grievance mechanism. Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date. Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required. Reporting Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements. Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders. Teamwork and culture Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met. Stay current on emerging best practices in NbS and carbon projects;
proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners. Skills and attributes To perform successfully in this role, you will have: A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers. Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science. Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups. Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams. A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision. A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects. Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting. A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery. Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position. Location Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or Bahia Submission instructions Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have. - Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Sua atuação contribuirá diretamente para a qualidade, confiabilidade e acessibilidade dos dados, sendo um membro fundamental na equipe de engenharia de dados. Como será seu dia a dia? Apoiar a construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados no Databricks, utilizando notebooks, jobs e pipelines;
Garantir a entrega contínua das camadas Bronze, Silver e Gold dentro da arquitetura de dados;
Ingerir, transformar edisponibilizar dados para consumo analítico;
Criar e manter tabelasDelta e views para suporte a dashboards e análises;
Atuar com compartilhamento e consumo de dados via Delta Sharing;
Apoiar a governança dedados utilizando Unity Catalog, gerenciando catálogos, schemas e permissões;
Monitorar execuções depipelines, identificar falhas e realizar troubleshooting;
Corrigir causas-raiz epropor melhorias de confiabilidade e performance;
Implementar e/ou apoiar validações de qualidade de dados;
Documentar pipelines, regras de negócio e a linhagem básica dos dados;

Conhecimento prático de Python para dados (manipulação, leitura/escrita e organização de código em notebooks);
Noções de Apache Spark/Databricks (DataFrames, particionamento, leitura/escrita em Delta e execução distribuída em alto nível);
Experiência inicial com Databricks (uso de notebooks, jobs, clusters e boas práticas básicas);
Familiaridadecom pipelines de dados e arquitetura Medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold), mesmo em contexto acadêmico ou projetos;
Conhecimento em Git e controle de versão (branch, PR e resolução simples de conflitos);
Capacidade deinvestigar problemas (logs, métricas simples, reprocessamentos) e comunicar status com clareza;
Disponibilidade para atuar com sustentação de rotinas, acompanhando falhas e correções dentro do horário acordado. Você pode se destacar se: Tiver experiência com Azure Data Factory (pipelines, triggers, integrações, parâmetros, monitoramento). Possuir conhecimento prático de Unity Catalog (permissões, data access, boas práticas de governança). Tiver vivência com Delta Sharing (publicação/consumo e cuidados com segurança e contratos de dados). Possuir experiência com orquestração e automação (Databricks Workflows, CI/CD, Databricks Repos, Azure DevOps/GitHub Actions). Tiver conhecimento em Data Quality e Observabilidade (ex.: Great Expectations/Deequ, métricas, SLIs/SLOs, alertas). Possuir experiência em otimização no Databricks/Delta (partitioning, Z-ORDER, OPTIMIZE/VACUUM, caching, controle de custos). Tiver noções de modelagem dimensional e consumo por ferramentas de BI (camadas semânticas, performance para dashboards). Possuir conhecimento de segurança e boas práticas (RBAC, segregação de ambientes, secrets, princípios de menor privilégio). Curtiu a oportunidade? Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente! ✨

Medical Science Liaison, (Rio de Janeiro, Brazil) page is loaded## Medical Science Liaison, (Rio de Janeiro, Brazil)locations: Brazil - Fieldtime type: Full timeposted on: Posted Yesterdayjob requisition id: REQ-4076*Join us as we transform immunology and deliver medicines that help autoimmune patients get their lives back. argenx is preparing for multi-dimensional expansion to reach more patients through a rich pipeline of differentiated assets, led by VYVGART, our first-in-class neonatal Fc receptor blocker approved for the treatment of gMG, and with the potential to treat patients across dozens of severe autoimmune diseases.**We are building a new kind of biotech company, one that maintains its roots as a science-based start-up and pushes our commitment to innovate across all corners of our business. We strive to inspire and grow our company, our partnerships, our science, and our people, because when we do, we deliver more for patients.***Join argenx** At argenx, we build our culture from the collective power of the team and the knowledge that together, we are better. If you are entrepreneurial, curious and committed to making a difference for patients and thrive on creating solutions for rare autoimmune diseases, then argenx is for you.We offer you the chance to grow and be a part of a team driven by purpose, creativity, innovation and science.**argenx**argenx is a fast-growing global immunology company committed to improving the lives of people suffering from severe autoimmune diseases. We translate immunology breakthroughs into a world-class portfolio of novel antibody-based medicines.For the expansion of our Brazilian team, argenx is looking for a Medical Science Liaison (MSL)**The Medical Science Liaison (MSL)** is a field-based expert on argenx’s scientific data, products and trials, responsible for engagement with healthcare providers and other relevant stakeholders at centers across the country. The MSL will represent and reflect argenx’s values as a science-driven, patient-centric organization developing innovative medicines for patients, and always upholding the highest ethical standards. The MSL is critical in understanding the management of diseases of interest, mapping the patient journey, identifying unmet medical needs, data gaps, areas of collaboration, and sharing insights to enhance patient care. The MSL will work closely with the Medical Affairs team and cross-functionally with all relevant colleagues in argenx, locally and globally.**ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES****Expert medical resource and argenx ambassador*** Develop and continuously maintain the highest scientific and medical expertise of all relevant diseases, products, development plans, and be acknowledged internally and externally as an expert* Build, cultivate, and leverage effective relationships with key external scientific and medical thought leaders, healthcare professionals, and professional organizations to strengthen collaboration and maintain a deep understanding of evolving healthcare trends across the relevant therapeutic landscape* Support the development and implementation of Strategic Territory Plans to advance Medical Affairs strategy and drive impactful outcomes within and across the territory* Maintain a high level of knowledge of and appropriately implement current local pharmaceutical regulation and ensure implementation of argenx policies and procedures.**Scientific/medical exchange and education, and insight generation*** Ensure timely and informative scientific/medical exchanges with external stakeholders that accurately reflect scientific data* Deliver high-quality scientific/medical education in a variety of settings, compliantly and in line with medical strategy* Obtain actionable insights on key interest topics that can be disseminated throughout the organization to drive strategy and focus* Coordinate the timely and appropriate response to internal and external medical enquiries, utilizing argenx medical information resources and in line with regulatory requirements* Attend appropriate local, national and international meetings and congresses to gather intelligence, develop productive collaborations, engage in scientific exchange and ensure insights are shared within argenx* Identify potential high-impact medical research projects and publication opportunities, in line with argenx areas of interest* Ensure all relevant knowledge, including activities and interactions with important contacts, is systematically captured and disseminated within argenx as appropriate* Ensure all external interactions are conducted in accordance with argenx objectives, compliance policies and procedures as well as with established legal, regulatory and ethical standards**Cross-functional collaboration*** Ensure a close working relationship with all argenx functions* Support cross-functional teams to ensure operations are patient-focused, including rapidly responding to internal and external requests to discuss specific situations and challenges and provide medical affairs support to all stakeholders.* Develop and maintain strong, productive relationships with investigators and participating clinical study sites, leveraging their involvement in argenx‑sponsored research to enhance scientific engagement, while maintaining deep knowledge of study design to provide accurate, high‑quality scientific support when needed.**SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES*** Demonstrated capability to accurately and critically evaluate medical and scientific literature, identifying strengths and limitations of study design and results, interpreting their potential impact on clinical practice and patient outcomes, and translating these insights into actionable recommendations that support Medical Affairs strategy development* Entrepreneurial spirit and ability to both achieve results independently and partner with colleagues across functions and geographies.* Strong influencing skills to be able to engage effectively with stakeholders and within the company.* Ability to quickly understand: + complex disease areas, treatments and clinical development plans + healthcare landscape, hospitals, healthcare professionals, patient journey + the broader healthcare policy context including especially market access processes.* Demonstrated ability to build strategic collaborations with medical experts* Excellent communication skills—verbal, written, and presentation—in both Portuguese and English, and effective in multicultural and multilingual environments.* Proven track record of delivering results that meet or exceed targeted objectives* Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively and effectively within cross‑functional teams and networks* Agile, adaptable, resilient, and comfortable operating with ambiguity;
thrives in a dynamic, complex, fast‑moving, and frequently changing environment* Project management skills with proactive planning, priority setting, and alignment-building* Highly outcome‑driven, ambitious, curious, quick to learn, and committed to continuous self‑development and constructive feedback* Passionate about contributing to and role‑modeling argenx’s corporate values of **co-creation, innovation, empowerment, excellence, and humility.****EDUCATION AND EXPERIEN****CE REQUIRED*** Scientific, healthcare or medical degrees (MS, PharmD, PhD, MD, RN, PA)* Significant field-based experience in the biopharmaceutical industry in medical affairs* Clinical experience in neurology, immunology and/or rare diseases is an advantage* Knowledge of regulations and practices related to industry interactions with healthcare professionals**OTHER*** Valid driver’s license* Ability for ≥50% travel* Bilingual*At argenx, all applicants are welcomed in an inclusive environment. They will receive equal consideration for employment without discrimination on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation,#J-18808-Ljbffr

Experiência colaborando em projetos com arquitetos de soluções ou times comerciais.

title: Head Of Legal

Our vision is simple but bold:to sequester gigatons of CO2while regenerating tropical soils in order to create a livable planet with nutritious food and healthy ecosystems for future generations. We’re doing this in partnership with farmers, scientists, and industry leaders - and we’re growing fast. Our company culture blends people-first care andperformance excellence. The Rocket represents our ambition and drive;

This role is well suited to someone who has experience leading legal functions within a fast-growing, ambitious startup, or who has worked closely with startup ventures as a trusted legal advisor. business-oriented legal roles (e.G., General Counsel, senior associate in relevant practice areas)- Solid experience with:- Corporate law and governance- Investor relations and strategic partnerships- Fluency in English, with experience working in international environmentsKey Qualities- Business-oriented mindset: understands legal as a driver of growth- Highly relational: strong stakeholder management across cultures and functions- Strategic thinker: connects science, operations, and business into legal frameworks- Pragmatic and solution-driven: balances risk with execution speed- High ownership: comfortable operating as a senior, autonomous leader in a lean structure- Strong institutional presence: capable of representing the company externally- Structured and integrative: able to navigate and connect multiple regulatory domains- Neutral and sound judgment, especially in complex or sensitive mattersBonus Points (but not essential)- Experience in environmental, mining, agribusiness, or carbon markets- Background in startups, scale-ups, or boutique law firms- Exposure to governance and international structures- Postgraduate degree (LL.M., ESG, Business Law, etc.)- Business and legal experience in Germany- Speaks German- Based in a city with relatively easy access to Sao Paulo/SPLiving Our ValuesAt InPlanet, we have a big vision of solving climate change, and we We're building a best-in-class product with world-class talent to serve customers who rave about us. Will you join us?About you:This is a direct-hire role. As a Customer Retention Specialist, your primary responsibility is to reduce churn and protect revenue. You will proactively engage canceled and churned accounts via calls, text, and emails to understand why. Most importantly, you'll be the bridge that enables customer success, helping us retain them. As a result, retained revenue will follow with subscription renewals, of which you will be responsible for attaining a monthly quota.What You'll Own:Responsible for reducing churn by retaining customers and revenue.You'll own a monthly customer retention quota as your main KPI.Apply approved retention strategies (in-app credits, billing credits, plan downgrades, and success enablement) within defined guidelines.Intercept downgrade requests and reposition value through usage planning, campaign scheduling, and ROI alignment before the plan change is approved.Identify and recover failed onboarding cases by re-driving activation and time-to-first-value.Perform proactive outreach to low-usage and disengaged accounts using structured "silent churn" playbooks to re-engage customers before cancellation intent surfaces.Working with the Success team, diagnose root causes of underperformance (targeting, messaging, timing, setup) and implement corrective actions that directly improve campaign outcomes.What We're Looking For:5+ years in a customer retention or account management role.3+ years within a SaaS company.Conduct 50+ weekly retention calls via phone or Google Meet.Proven ability to analyze customer behavior, identify churn risks, and take targeted action to retain accounts.Strong objection handling, negotiation, and behavioral communication skills with the ability to influence customer decisions under pressure.Ability to diagnose and act on different churn drivers (budget, usage, performance, lifecycle, compliance) with tailored retention strategies.Able to work efficiently in a high-activity environment without sacrificing quality.Comfortable holding long-format video calls for reviewing customer accounts and demonstrating product value.Coachable, performance-driven, accountable, and a strong team player.Proficient or native level English (full business fluency).Work a minimum of 40 hours/week between 10 am and 7 pm EST, Monday to Friday.Bonus Points:Experience working at a CPaaS or Martech SaaS company.Experience working with real estate professionals.️ Why Smarter Contact?USD base compensation15 days PTO + 5 sick days + 10 floating holidays (6 weeks off)High autonomy, fast execution, real impactProfessional development benefitWellness benefitEmployment anniversary and birthday giftQuarterly health allowanceRemote-first team with a strong performance cultureThis opportunity is offered as a full-time independent contractor rolePlease Don't Apply If:You prefer a low-pressure, low-output environmentYou're not fluent in English or are uncomfortable communicating directly with cross-functional teamsYou don't meet the minimum customer success experienceNo experience working for a SaaS companyReady to grow with us?We're looking for a proven Customer Retention Specialist ready to build the next chapter of their career — and stay for the long haul. If that's you, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Full-Time Project Lead
description: About UsBlueTuskr is a rapidly growing full-service digital marketing agency specializing in e-commerce brands. Our team is highly collaborative and committed to delivering exceptional results for our clients, helping them grow and scale their businesses.As we continue to expand, we're looking for a full-time Project Lead to join our team and oversee the day-to-day pipeline of client projects. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced agency environment and enjoys bringing structure, organization, and momentum to complex marketing initiatives.What You'll Be DoingYou'll be responsible for managing the lifecycle of multiple client projects, ensuring timelines are met, teams stay aligned, and deliverables meet client expectations. This role sits at the center of our internal operations, coordinating efforts across design, content, strategy, and paid media teams while maintaining clear communication with stakeholders.The ideal candidate has:3-5 years of project management experience1-2 years of marketing agency experience ( some e-commerce experience is preferred).A strong understanding of marketing workflows, including content creation, paid media, SEO, and creative production.Proficiency in project management tools, especially Asana.Excellent organizational and time-management skills.Exceptional communication and interpersonal abilities.A problem-solving mindset with a focus on continuous improvement.The ability to multitask and manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.KEY RESPONSIBILITIES1. Project Planning & Execution (50% of your time)Develop and manage detailed project plans, timelines, and budgets.Break down projects into actionable tasks and assign responsibilities across teams.Ensure tasks are completed on time, within scope, and aligned with client goals.Proactively identify and resolve potential roadblocks.Monitor progress, making adjustments to plans as needed to stay on track.2. Team Coordination & Communication (30% of your time)Serve as the main point of contact between internal teams and clients.Facilitate regular check-ins, stand-ups, and progress meetings.Ensure seamless communication and collaboration between departments (design, content, strategy, etc.).Provide clear direction and ensure team members understand priorities and deadlines.Foster a positive, productive environment and help remove any obstacles.3. Performance Monitoring & Reporting (20% of your time)Track project performance, including key metrics like timeline adherence, budget management, and client satisfaction.Prepare and present progress reports to leadership and clients.Analyze project data to identify areas for improvement in efficiency and processes.Contribute to refining workflows and improving project management methodologies.SalaryThe starting salary for this position is between $3000 and $3500 USD per month, depending on experience.SO, if you are a highly motivated and skilled Project Manager with experience in marketing and e-commerce, AND you'd like to have the opportunity to join a growing marketing agency and be part of an invaluable team, we can't wait to hear from you!
